response.sql:
WITH counts AS (
  SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(*) AS analysis_count
  FROM advancedbehavior AS a
  JOIN transactionrecord AS tr ON a.translink = tr.transreg
  JOIN trader AS t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg
  GROUP BY t.tradekind
), shares AS (
  SELECT tradekind, analysis_count,
         1.0 * analysis_count / SUM(analysis_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM counts
), scored AS (
  SELECT tradekind, analysis_count, share,
         AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share
  FROM shares
)
SELECT tradekind, analysis_count, share, share - average_share AS share_minus_average
FROM scored
WHERE average_share IS NOT NULL
  AND share > average_share;

assumptions.assumption: Each matching advancedbehavior row counts as one analysis; exact text joins exclude rows without a matching transaction and trader. NULL tradekind values form one group, as SQLite GROUP BY groups them together.
